Hello — and what this site is for

A short intro to bodesigns: what I’m writing about, who it’s for, and what to expect.

I built this site as a place to think out loud about product design, AI, systems thinking, and the business of shipping software.

Topics on deck:

  • How I'm using AI inside my design practice (and where it falls short)
  • What good systems thinking looks like in enterprise products
  • Notes from 20+ years of working on FinTech, e-commerce, payments and HR

If you'd like to follow along, the easiest way is to bookmark /blog — RSS is coming soon.
